issues: 画面上方是调试占位标题 "AXIS RESCALE SHOCK V2"，爆表段冲出去插进的是卡名
卡片 2px 灰边 + 单层淡影、2px 灰网格、3px 灰色上沿条，线框稿质感
冲顶用 in-cubic 以最高速硬停，卡片震动是等幅正弦；粗细 10→6 一帧跳变
重标时四个刻度同帧换、加密网格同帧出现，像切图而不是“哗”地重排
端点标记 / $340k 标签是平涂色块，没有落座感和增幅信息
changes: 调试标题换成页面级标题区：左 Revenue overview，右 FY total KPI——爆表段正好冲进 KPI 数字，重标完成时合计从 $493k 滚到 $833k
卡片发丝线 + 内高光 + 两层软影、柔光背景 + 颗粒；1px 发丝网格、虚线天花板在顶破前一拍连同 $100k 刻度转琥珀
折线下加淡面积渐变、画线期笔尖带头灯；冲顶用越冲越快再 8% 过冲的贝塞尔，冲出段带柔光，粗细 10→6 平滑收回；震动改阻尼正弦（±8px，约 10f 收敛）
重标：刻度自上而下错峰 2f 换位并带瞬时纵向虚化，加密网格错峰从左向右展开
端点标记 overshoot 落座 + 一圈涟漪；真值标签改渐变胶囊 + 指向角 + “▲ 372% vs Nov” 副行；补导出 AXIS_RESCALE_SHOCK_V2_DURATION = 150
issuesEn: A debug title "AXIS RESCALE SHOCK V2" sat above the chart, so the spike pierced the card name
2px grey card border with a faint single shadow, 2px grey gridlines and a 3px grey top bar read as a wireframe
The spike used in-cubic and stopped dead at full speed; the card shake was an undamped sine; stroke width jumped 10→6 in one frame
All four ticks swapped and the dense gridlines appeared on the same frame, like a cut rather than a rescale
The end marker and $340k label were flat blocks with no settle and no growth context
changesEn: Replaced the debug title with a page header: Revenue overview on the left and an FY total KPI on the right that the spike punches through; the total rolls from $493k to $833k when the rescale lands
Hairline card with inner highlight and two-layer shadow on a soft-light backdrop with grain; 1px gridlines and a dashed ceiling that turns amber (with the $100k tick) just before it breaks
Soft area fill and a pen-tip highlight while drawing; the spike accelerates then overshoots ~8% with a glow, stroke eases 10→6, and the shake is a damped sine (±8px, ~10f)
Rescale ticks swap top-down with a 2f stagger and brief vertical blur; dense gridlines wipe in left to right with stagger
End marker settles with overshoot plus one ripple; value label is a gradient pill with pointer and a ▲ 372% vs Nov sub-line; exported AXIS_RESCALE_SHOCK_V2_DURATION = 150
